text:
deploy-bot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECK FAILED — release v2.14.2 promotion paused by deploy-bot. Reason: env parity mismatch. Details:
- feature_flag.enable_heuristic: staging=true, prod=false
- secret path: staging -> `secrets/staging/inference/relay` present, prod -> `secrets/prod/inference/relay` MISSING
- release pinned to model: `quant-variant-v2` (pin prevents fallback)
See preflight: https://deploy.reports/1713456789/report

margo: Ack. Flag + missing secret together will change behaviour. Do we want to hotfix prod flag or backfill secret? :thinking_face:

raj: I'd avoid flipping the global flag in prod without rollout. The pin was intentional to avoid quality regressions. Prefer backfill secret and then promote.

lia: Can we unpin model for a canary subset only? That reduces risk while we fix config. Might be extra work in orchestrator.

jen-sre: Change window ends in ~2h. If we do a hotfix we need product signoff and an ops window. Tagging @clare-product for decision.

oliver: @clare-product the heuristic default flip was only tested in staging during the experiment. Prod being false was deliberate, right? Also why did the secret disappear from prod?

clare-product: Prod should have remained unchanged. We did not intend a prod flag flip. Secret disappearance looks like a config drift from the infra repo merge last week — likely an accidental namespace rename. Do NOT flip flag in prod without rollout plan.

margo: Proposal: backfill `secrets/prod/inference/relay` from staging copy (sanitized), keep model pin, run canary smoke (flag=true) and then promote. Backfill requires KMS unwrap + audit.

raj: +1. Make sure to record secret version in the release notes and include the audit key. Also update pin rationale in the notes so SRE knows why we kept quant-variant-v2.

lia: If we backfill, run a canary with the flag enabled and pinned model to verify perf/accuracy before full rollout. I can rig the canary test.

jen-sre: I can run the backfill and smoke. ETA 45m. Will capture logs and KMS audit entries.

deploy-bot: Action created: #ticket-4452 (prod secret backfill), #ticket-4453 (canary smoke test), assignees: margo/jen-sre. Release remains PAUSED until tasks clear.

clare-product: Approved: backfill + canary. Please add an explicit bullet in release notes: `feature_flag.enable_heuristic parity enforced; secret backfilled; model pin retained` so downstream teams are aware.

margo: Will update release notes and mark changelog: "hotfix: align prod config with staging; backfilled inference relay secret; kept quant-variant-v2 pin for quality stability." Pinging @deployops when done.

jen-sre: Backfill complete. KMS unwrap id: kms-op-789; secret v2 deployed to `secrets/prod/inference/relay`. Smoke results: `200 OK`, latencies within SLO, basic quality checks passed. Logs: `smoke/1713456820.log`

margo: Unpausing now. deploy-bot, please resume promotion.

deploy-bot: Resume requested by margo. Promotion resumed for v2.14.2. Post-deploy hooks running.

deploy-bot: Promotion SUCCESS. All post-deploy checks green. Release notes updated: https://releases.redwood/v2.14.2/notes (includes audit refs #ticket-4452, #ticket-4453). :tada:
